title: conformance report
description: What check conformance finds, from check conformance -o json: each block that binds code, checked against that code. A block not built yet is a fact, not a fault, so a finding never fails the check. Paths are the machine's, shown on purpose behind the token, as the board names its project's folder (ED-RUN-2). Probes stay closed until the flows-and-tracing talk.

apiVersion.description: Always elderlygate/designer/app/v1: the form of e-designer's answers. An app's answers keep the family app (apiversion/v1/forms.yaml), apart from the files they describe.

kind.description: Always ConformanceReport, the kind of this answer, so a reader knows which schema its data meets.

ran.description: Where the answer came from; this contract fixes the app and the contract version, so an answer from anything else fails here.

app.description: Always designer, e-designer's product ID, since only e-designer gives this answer.

contract.description: Always v1, the contract version this schema belongs to.

data.description: Where the code is, and each block's state.

root.description: The code's root as configured; absent when none is.

source.description: Where the root came from, an open word. Known words: env: ED_IMPL_ROOT; file: the design's implementation setting; checkout: the checkout around the design; none: nowhere.

problem.description: Why no block could be checked, such as a root that is not there; absent when the check ran.

at.description: When it was checked, in milliseconds since the epoch.

blocks.description: One per block, in the design's order.

state.description: What was found, an open word. Known words: unbound: it binds no code; missing: the file or symbol is not there; mismatch: the members differ; present: the code is there and agrees.

binding.description: The binding as written on the block.

method.description: How the members were found, which says how much the state means. Known words: structural: from the code's own blocks; text: by searching its text; none: not at all.

missingMembers.description: Members the board expects and the code does not have.

extraMembers.description: Members the code has and the board does not register.

found.description: Every member the code exposes, so a mismatch can be read.

counts.description: How many blocks are in each state, by its word.
